title: 时态总览
summary: 从时间参照点和动作状态选择时态。一般时常写习惯或完整事件，进行时侧重某时正在发生，完成时从参照点回看此前的经历或结果。will 可以表达预测或临时决定。
pitfall: 先圈出时间参照。yesterday 指已经结束的过去时间，通常用一般过去时。

examples.en: I cycle to work on Fridays.
examples.cn: 我周五骑车上班。

examples.en: I was cycling when it began to rain.
examples.cn: 开始下雨时，我正在骑车。

examples.en: She has lost her keys.
examples.cn: 她把钥匙弄丢了。

examples.en: I'll open the window.
examples.cn: 我来开窗吧。

questions.prompt: Nina usually ____ lunch at noon.
questions.explanation: usually 描述习惯，主语为第三人称单数，用 has。

questions.prompt: At eight last night, we ____ dinner when the lights went out.
questions.explanation: 在过去某一时刻正在进行，用过去进行时。

questions.prompt: I ____ this bag yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示具体过去时间，用 bought。

questions.prompt: Look! The dog ____ in the river.
questions.explanation: Look 提示观察当下正在发生的事。

questions.prompt: I'll call you when I ____ home tonight.
questions.explanation: when 引导将来时间状语从句时，常用一般现在时。

title: 现在完成时
summary: have 或 has 加过去分词。用来谈截至现在的经历、仍在持续的状态，或过去事件对现在造成的结果。since 后接起点，for 后接时长。
pitfall: 结束了的具体时间通常用过去时。描述持续状态可用 have lived 或 have been，而瞬时动作需改写。

examples.en: I have just sent the report.
examples.cn: 我刚发完报告。

examples.en: We have lived here since 2020.
examples.cn: 我们从 2020 年就住在这里。

examples.en: Have you ever tried skiing?
examples.cn: 你试过滑雪吗？

examples.en: She hasn't replied yet.
examples.cn: 她还没有回复。

questions.prompt: We have been friends ____ ten years.
questions.explanation: ten years 是一段时间，用 for。

questions.prompt: Sam has worked here ____ July.
questions.explanation: July 在这里是起点，用 since。

questions.prompt: Ava has ____ her homework, so she can go out.
questions.explanation: has 后用过去分词 finished。

questions.prompt: I ____ my cousin last Sunday.
questions.explanation: last Sunday 指明已结束的过去时间。

questions.prompt: Where is Mia? She ____ to the shops and will be back soon.
questions.explanation: has gone 表示去了且尚未回来。

title: 被动语态
summary: 被动语态突出承受动作的人或物。基本形式是 be 加过去分词，时态由 be 体现。执行者有必要时用 by 引入。
pitfall: 区分过去式和过去分词，例如 wrote 是过去式，written 是过去分词。不及物动词通常不能直接变成被动。

examples.en: The doors are locked at nine.
examples.cn: 门在九点锁上。

examples.en: The parcel was delivered this morning.
examples.cn: 包裹今天早上送到了。

examples.en: The bridge will be repaired next month.
examples.cn: 桥将在下个月维修。

examples.en: The forms have been checked.
examples.cn: 表格已经检查过了。

questions.prompt: The room ____ every morning.
questions.explanation: 房间是被打扫的，every morning 表示常规。

questions.prompt: The picture was ____ by a child.
questions.explanation: was 后接过去分词 painted。

questions.prompt: The winners will ____ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 将来时被动是 will be 加过去分词。

questions.prompt: The old tickets ____ yesterday.
questions.explanation: 主语是复数且时间在过去，用 were sold。

questions.prompt: Which verb can complete “The key was ____ on the desk”?
questions.explanation: leave 可以带宾语，be left 表示被留下。

title: 定语从句
summary: 定语从句修饰其前的名词。who 指人，which 指物，that 可用于限定性从句，whose 表所属。非限定性从句用逗号隔开，补充额外信息。
pitfall: 关系词在限定性从句中作宾语时可省略，作主语时要保留。逗号后的非限定性从句一般不用 that。

examples.en: The cyclist who won is my neighbour.
examples.cn: 获胜的自行车手是我的邻居。

examples.en: This is the cup that you bought.
examples.cn: 这就是你买的杯子。

examples.en: I met a writer whose novel won a prize.
examples.cn: 我遇到一位小说获奖的作家。

examples.en: The garden, which opens at ten, is free.
examples.cn: 花园十点开放，免费入内。

questions.prompt: The man ____ fixed our bike lives upstairs.
questions.explanation: 先行词是人，关系词作从句主语。

questions.prompt: That's the artist ____ work I admire.
questions.explanation: 表示那位艺术家的作品，用 whose。

questions.prompt: The hall, ____ was built in 1902, is still in use.
questions.explanation: 非限定性从句中指物并作主语，用 which。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with an optional relative pronoun.
options: The dog that barked ran away.
I know a nurse who works here.
The film that we saw was funny.
The bus which arrived was full.
questions.explanation: that 在从句 we saw 中作宾语，可以省略。

questions.prompt: This is the park ____ we first met.
questions.explanation: we first met 结构完整，缺地点状语，用 where。

title: 虚拟语气
summary: 和现在事实相反常用 if 加过去式，主句用 would 加动词原形。回想过去未发生的情况，用 if 加 had done，主句用 would have done。wish 可表达遗憾，某些正式建议结构使用动词原形。
pitfall: 普通条件句的 if 从句不用 would 表结果。If I were you 是常用的假设表达。

examples.en: If I were you, I would wait.
examples.cn: 如果我是你，我会等一等。

examples.en: If we had left earlier, we would have caught the bus.
examples.cn: 如果我们早点出发，就赶上公交车了。

examples.en: I wish I knew the answer.
examples.cn: 要是我知道答案就好了。

examples.en: They suggested that he take a break.
examples.cn: 他们建议他休息一下。

questions.prompt: If I ____ you, I would save a copy.
questions.explanation: 对现在情况作假设，If I were you 是固定常用表达。

questions.prompt: If you had called, I ____ you up.
questions.explanation: 对过去未发生的结果用 would have 加过去分词。

questions.prompt: I wish I ____ more free time now.
questions.explanation: now 提示对当前情况的遗憾，用过去式 had。

questions.prompt: The doctor recommended that she ____ at home.
questions.explanation: 正式建议从句可使用动词原形 stay。

questions.prompt: If the shop were open now, we ____ a map there.
questions.explanation: 对现在的假设结果可以用 could 加动词原形。

title: 非谓语动词
summary: 不定式常表目的或跟在特定动词后，动名词可作主语或宾语，分词可修饰名词或补充情境。词形选择需要结合搭配和主动、被动关系。
pitfall: 分词短语的逻辑主语应与主句主语一致。stop doing 表示停止做某事，stop to do 表示停下来做另一件事。

examples.en: She went outside to answer the phone.
examples.cn: 她到外面接电话去了。

examples.en: I enjoy cooking for friends.
examples.cn: 我喜欢为朋友做饭。

examples.en: The book written by Lin is on the shelf.
examples.cn: 林写的书在书架上。

examples.en: Walking home, I saw a fox.
examples.cn: 走路回家时，我看见一只狐狸。

questions.prompt: We came here ____ the exhibition.
questions.explanation: 不定式表来到这里的目的。

questions.prompt: He avoids ____ at rush hour.
questions.explanation: avoid 后用动名词作宾语。

questions.prompt: The bicycle ____ last week has been found.
questions.explanation: 自行车被偷，用过去分词作后置定语。

questions.prompt: On the hike they stopped ____ some water.
questions.explanation: 停下步行去喝水，stop to do。

questions.prompt: Which sentence has a clear subject for the opening phrase?
options: Leaving the station, the rain began.
Leaving the station, I felt a drop of rain.
Leaving the station, the road was wet.
Leaving the station, it got darker.
questions.explanation: 离开车站的人是主句中的 I。

title: 倒装
summary: 否定或限制副词前置时，有时需要把助动词移到主语之前。only 加状语前置时，倒装通常发生在主句。原句无助动词时使用 do、does 或 did。
pitfall: only 修饰主语时不触发倒装，如 Only Mina knew the answer。区分主句和前置状语从句。

examples.en: Never have I seen such heavy rain.
examples.cn: 我从没见过这么大的雨。

examples.en: Only later did we understand the rule.
examples.cn: 直到后来我们才懂这条规则。

examples.en: Not until noon did the fog lift.
examples.cn: 直到中午雾才散去。

examples.en: Rarely does this bus arrive early.
examples.cn: 这班车很少提前到达。

questions.prompt: Never ____ I heard such a clear recording.
questions.explanation: heard 在此为过去分词，构成现在完成时倒装。

questions.prompt: Only after the test ____ the mistake.
questions.explanation: only 加时间状语前置，主句用 did + 主语 + 原形。

questions.prompt: Rarely ____ she miss a lesson.
questions.explanation: 一般现在时，第三人称单数使用 does。

questions.prompt: Only Mina ____ the answer yesterday.
questions.explanation: Only 修饰主语 Mina，不倒装。yesterday 对应过去式。

questions.prompt: Not until the bus arrived ____ our seats.
questions.explanation: 主句用 did we find，从句保持正常语序。

title: 主谓一致
summary: 先找主语中心词，再选择谓语。each、every 等常带单数谓语。and 连接不同主体通常用复数。there be 句型在正式书面语中应注意后置主语的数。
pitfall: 介词短语中的名词不会改变主语中心词的数。不可数名词如 advice、information 通常用单数谓语。

examples.en: The box of old photographs is upstairs.
examples.cn: 装着老照片的箱子在楼上。

examples.en: Each of the rooms has a window.
examples.cn: 每间房都有一扇窗。

examples.en: My brother and his partner are visiting.
examples.cn: 我哥哥和他的伴侣要来做客。

examples.en: There are two messages on your phone.
examples.cn: 你手机上有两条消息。

questions.prompt: The list of names ____ on the wall.
questions.explanation: 中心词是单数 list。

questions.prompt: Each of the players ____ a locker.
questions.explanation: each 作主语时通常用单数谓语。

questions.prompt: The teacher and her assistant ____ waiting for us.
questions.explanation: and 连接两个不同的人，用复数。

questions.prompt: The information ____ correct.
questions.explanation: information 是不可数名词，谓语用单数。

questions.prompt: There ____ three bowls on the shelf.
questions.explanation: 后置主语 three bowls 是复数。

title: 情态动词
summary: 情态动词通常接动词原形。can 表能力或许可，should 表建议，must 表义务或有把握的推断，might 表不确定的可能性。推断过去可用 must have + 过去分词，表示过去某次成功可用 managed to。
pitfall: mustn’t 表禁止，don’t have to 表无需做某事。情态动词后别再加 to 或第三人称单数 -s。

examples.en: You can leave your coat by the door.
examples.cn: 你可以把外套放在门边。

examples.en: You should ask for a copy of the agreement.
examples.cn: 你应该要一份协议副本。

examples.en: The lights are off, so they must have left already.
examples.cn: 灯都关了，他们一定已经离开了。

examples.en: We managed to open the shed before the rain started.
examples.cn: 下雨前，我们设法打开了棚屋。

questions.prompt: There’s no dress code. You ____ wear a suit.
questions.explanation: 没有着装规定，意思是无需穿西装。

questions.prompt: Visitors ____ touch the wet paint. The sign says it is forbidden.
questions.explanation: forbidden 表示明令禁止，mustn’t 与之对应。

questions.prompt: I’m not sure why the delivery is late. The van ____ be stuck in traffic.
questions.explanation: 说话者并不确定，用 might 加动词原形表示一种可能性。

questions.prompt: The floor is still wet. The cleaner must have ____ a few minutes ago.
questions.explanation: must have 后用过去分词 left，推断刚刚发生的事。

questions.prompt: In spite of the stiff latch, we ____ open the window yesterday.
questions.explanation: 叙述过去一次实际成功的动作，用 managed to open。

title: 比较结构
summary: 用 -er 或 more 构成比较级，用 as + 原级 + as 表同等程度。much 和 far 可加强比较级。用 the + 比较级, the + 比较级表示两种变化之间的关系。最高级通常用 the + 最高级，并注明比较范围。
pitfall: 避免 more cheaper 一类双重比较。比较对象也要对齐，例如 the rent here is lower than that in town，比较两地的租金。

examples.en: The new lamp is much brighter than the old one.
examples.cn: 新灯比旧灯亮得多。

examples.en: This box is as wide as the shelf.
examples.cn: 这个箱子和架子一样宽。

examples.en: The longer we wait, the colder the soup gets.
examples.cn: 等得越久，汤就越凉。

examples.en: Of the three bags, the canvas one is the lightest.
examples.cn: 这三个包里，帆布的最轻。

questions.prompt: The borrowed ladder is ____ than ours.
questions.explanation: than 提示用比较级，tall 的比较级为 taller。

questions.prompt: The smaller room is just as warm ____ the larger one.
questions.explanation: 同等比较用 as + 形容词原级 + as。

questions.prompt: The more often I practise the tune, ____ it is to remember.
questions.explanation: 前后两个比较级都带 the，表示练习越多越容易记住。

questions.prompt: Of the four routes, this is ____ in winter.
questions.explanation: 从四条路中比较，用最高级 the safest。

questions.prompt: The rent on this street is lower than ____ on Hill Street.
questions.explanation: that 指代 the rent，使两边比较的都是租金。

title: 条件句：从真实到虚拟
summary: 一般规律可用 if + 一般现在时，主句也用一般现在时。开放的未来条件常用 if + 一般现在时，主句用 will 或祈使句。设想与现在事实不同，用 if + 过去式及 would + 原形。设想与过去事实不同，用 if + had + 过去分词及 would have + 过去分词。过去的条件也可影响现在，此时主句用 would + 原形。
pitfall: 虚拟条件从句的过去式可表示与现实的距离。普通未来条件用 If it rains tomorrow, ...。现在的虚拟假设中，正式用法常用 If I were ...。

examples.en: If this light is on, the door is locked.
examples.cn: 只要这盏灯亮着，门就是锁着的。

examples.en: If the rain stops by noon, we’ll eat outside.
examples.cn: 如果中午前雨停，我们就到外面吃。

examples.en: If I lived closer, I would walk to work.
examples.cn: 如果我住得更近，我就会走路上班。

examples.en: If I had saved the receipt, I would still have proof of purchase now.
examples.cn: 如果我当时留了小票，现在就还有购物凭证。

questions.prompt: Whenever this tank gets too full, water ____ out through the side pipe.
questions.explanation: whenever 描述反复发生的现象，单数主语 water 搭配 flows。

questions.prompt: If the parcel ____ tomorrow, I’ll bring it to the office.
questions.explanation: 将来可能发生的条件可用一般现在时。

questions.prompt: I don’t own a bike. If I ____ one, I would ride to class.
questions.explanation: 设想与现在事实相反的情况，if 从句用过去式。

questions.prompt: If we had seen the sign yesterday, we ____ at the earlier exit.
questions.explanation: 条件和结果都属于过去的假设，主句用 would have + 过去分词。

questions.prompt: If I had charged my phone last night, it ____ usable now.
questions.explanation: 充电是过去的假设，now 将结果定位在现在，主句用 would be。

title: 名词性从句
summary: 名词性从句可作主语、宾语、表语或补充名词内容。that 引出陈述内容，whether 引出是否类问题，what 可表示所……的事物，也可引出特指疑问。疑问词引导的从句用陈述语序。
pitfall: 嵌入问句时用 where the key is。that 在某些动词的宾语从句中可省略，但句首 that 主语从句应保留连接词。

examples.en: What she found in the drawer surprised us.
examples.cn: 她在抽屉里发现的东西让我们吃了一惊。

examples.en: We haven't decided whether we can stay overnight.
examples.cn: 我们还没决定能不能留宿。

examples.en: The problem is that neither key fits the lock.
examples.cn: 问题是两把钥匙都打不开这把锁。

examples.en: I heard the news that the footbridge had reopened.
examples.cn: 我听说人行桥已经重新开放了。

questions.prompt: Could you tell me where ____?
questions.explanation: where 在句内引导宾语从句，采用主语加谓语的陈述语序。

questions.prompt: ____ the team needed most was another quiet room.
questions.explanation: what 同时引导主语从句并作 needed 的宾语，表示团队最需要的东西。

questions.prompt: It depends on ____ the hall is free on Sunday.
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后用 whether 引出表示是否有空的从句。

questions.prompt: The trouble is ____ we have only one working microphone.
questions.explanation: 从句结构完整且说明问题的内容，表语从句用 that。

questions.prompt: The news ____ the hall would reopen came as a surprise.
questions.explanation: that 从句补充 news 的具体内容，在从句内不担任成分。
